scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @housefamily/shared" "npm run dev -w @housefamily/api" "node scripts/local-dev.mjs --web-after-api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @housefamily/shared && npm run build -w @housefamily/api && npm run build -w @housefamily/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @housefamily/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @housefamily/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @housefamily/shared && npm run build -w @housefamily/web
scripts.start:api: npm run db:migrate && npm run start -w @housefamily/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @housefamily/api && npm run test -w @housefamily/web
